key.name: enable-maximize-to-workspace
key.description: When a window is maximized, automatically move it to a new workspace. When unmaximized, return it to the previous workspace.

key.name: enable-stage-sidebar
key.description: Show a sidebar with inactive window thumbnails on the left side of the screen.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: Width of the stage manager sidebar in pixels.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration of sidebar show/hide animations in milliseconds.

key.name: sidebar-auto-hide
key.description: When off (default): the sidebar stays visible, drawn over your windows; the empty space around the cards passes clicks through to whatever is underneath. When on: the sidebar stays off screen and is revealed by moving the pointer to the left edge.

key.name: show-on-empty-workspace
key.description: When enabled, always show the sidebar when all windows on the current workspace are minimized (desktop is empty). Auto-hide resumes once the user interacts with a card and windows become visible again.

key.name: sidebar-reserve-space
key.description: Shrink the work area so maximized windows stop underneath the sidebar instead of being covered by it, the way macOS shifts the stage across. Only applies when auto-hide is off, because a reserved strut cannot animate.

key.name: auto-hide-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before hiding the sidebar after the pointer leaves.

key.name: edge-trigger-width
key.description: Width of the invisible hot zone at the screen edge to trigger the sidebar.

key.name: show-app-icons
key.description: Show application icons below window thumbnails in the sidebar.

key.name: sidebar-mode
key.description: What to show in sidebar cards. 'groups' = stage manager (swap groups), 'apps' = per-app (just focus), 'workspaces' = other workspaces, 'all-windows' = every window on every workspace (click to activate).

key.name: card-base-scale
key.description: Default card scale percentage (40-100). Cards grow on hover with a bell curve effect.

key.name: perspective-angle
key.description: Y-axis rotation in degrees for the 3D perspective effect on cards.

key.name: show-group-count
key.description: Show a window count badge on thumbnails when a group has multiple windows.

key.name: show-workspace-current
key.description: In workspace mode, also show the current workspace card in the sidebar.

key.name: toggle-sidebar
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle the stage sidebar visibility. Empty array means no shortcut is bound.

key.name: sidebar-layout
key.description: Vertical stack (default) or a full carousel arc layout — see arc-panel-position for which edge it attaches to.

key.name: arc-angle-step
key.description: Degrees between adjacent cards when sidebar-layout is 'arc'. Smaller values show more cards at once.

key.name: app-merge-map
key.description: Internal JSON map of appId to merge-group key, used by the 'apps' sidebar-mode's drag-to-merge feature. Not intended for manual editing.

key.name: stack-panel-position
key.description: Screen edge the Stack sidebar is attached to.

key.name: arc-panel-position
key.description: Screen edge the arc sidebar carousel is attached to.

key.name: arc-persistent-mode
key.description: Keep the arc sidebar shown whenever no window overlaps its area, instead of only on hover.

key.name: arc-card-scale
key.description: Card size percentage for the arc sidebar carousel.

key.name: arc-scroll-speed
key.description: Momentum-scroll speed for the arc sidebar carousel.

key.name: arc-merge-map
key.description: Internal JSON map of appId to merge-group key for the arc sidebar's drag-to-merge gesture. Not intended for manual editing.

key.name: arc-order-map
key.description: Internal JSON map of merge-group key to display order for the arc sidebar's drag-to-reorder gesture. Not intended for manual editing.

key.name: keybinding-arc-next
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to move the arc carousel to the next card.

key.name: keybinding-arc-prev
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to move the arc carousel to the previous card.

key.name: keybinding-arc-activate
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to activate the front card of the arc carousel.

key.name: keybinding-arc-close
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to close the front window of the arc carousel's front card.
